label: context.reference
text:
Use Unity MCP through world_mcp_unity. Installation, project policy admission, exact task binding and a live server are separate requirements. Octopus does not start the external server or assume Unity Editor is open.

Read its mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog for actual tools and schemas. Refresh with unity.list_tools. Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_unity, label mcp.operation.request, operation unity.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use unity.read_resource and unity.get_prompt with catalog identifiers; unity.status or unity.ping checks liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, event or refusal before reporting an edit, import, test, build or play-mode effect.
